findings.title: CPU starvation: meteo (prio 10) kept off the CPU up to 160 ms by comms (prio 20), 10 times
findings.root_cause: meteo (priority 10) was ready to run but waited up to 160 ms because comms (priority 20) kept the CPU, 10 times. With fixed-priority scheduling this is expected whenever a higher-priority thread is busy; it is a problem only if meteo has a deadline.
findings.fix: Bound the high-priority thread's CPU burst (sleep/yield or move work to a lower priority), use sporadic scheduling (SCHED_SPORADIC), or adaptive partitioning to guarantee a CPU budget.
